content.title: About
content.content: Pancakes, fruit, frozen are a ready‑to‑cook product consisting of thin pancakes that already contain pieces of berries and fruit. They are convenient to store in the freezer and can be quickly prepared on a skillet or in a microwave. The taste combines the softness of the batter with the sweet‑tart flavor of the fruit.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pancakes are often used as a quick breakfast or snack.
Typical fruit additions include strawberry, blueberry, banana and mango.
Freezing preserves most of the vitamins thanks to rapid flash‑freezing.
The classic pancake recipe originates from French crêpes.
In some countries they are served with yogurt or ice cream.

items.title: Source of vitamins
items.content: The fruit component provides vitamin C and vitamin A, which support immunity and vision.

items.title: Contains fiber
items.content: Fruit fiber aids digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The batter is prepared with minimal added oil, making the product suitable for moderate fat intake.

items.title: Quick energy source
items.content: Carbohydrates from the batter and fruit quickly replenish glycogen stores, useful before exercise.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Berries contain polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The batter may contain wheat, so people with celiac disease should choose a gluten‑free version.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Fruit additions can raise sugar levels, which is important for individuals with diabetes.

items.title: Additive concerns
items.content: Some manufacturers add preservatives; check the ingredient list if you are sensitive to food additives.

items.title: Risk of under‑heating
items.content: If not heated properly, the pancakes may remain cold inside, increasing the risk of food‑borne illness.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Defrost the pancakes in the microwave or on a skillet, then serve with yogurt, honey, nuts or fresh berries. They can also be used as a base for dessert rolls.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen pancakes in an airtight bag at –18 °C or lower. After thawing, consume within 24 hours and do not leave at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
